=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:132-134 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `text="${text%.} (pool: ${CLAUDE_POOL_REASON})."` is applied to the whole report after `pool_usage_report` has appended the ChatGPT section, so when Claude probes are `[]` the Claude reason lands on the last ChatGPT line (an account line or "ChatGPT accounts: unavailable (<reason>).") and not on the Claude headline.
  WHY: The Claude failure reason is shown against a ChatGPT line and the Claude headline loses its reason, which breaks the "Claude section format unchanged" requirement and the contract that tests/test_claude_pool_daily_usage.py:185-190 pins; four reviewers rated this MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1042, 1085-1087 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CHATGPT_STATUS_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$")` makes `_chatgpt_status_parse` silently drop account names longer than 64 characters, but the broker (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:174-175, `CHATGPT_ACCOUNT_NAME_RE = /^[A-Z0-9_]+$/`, "no length cap") accepts them.
  WHY: An account the broker accepts is left out of `chatgpt_accounts`, the hourly alert and the daily report, so its usage, auth_failed, refresh-failure and stale state are never reported and nothing is logged; four reviewers rated this MAJOR and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:171-196 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hourly alert text is sent through `tg_send_msg` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:108-134) with no length cap, and the ChatGPT block (scripts/claude_engine.py:1266-1275) lists every account with its full causes, while the daily script does truncate (scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:137-152).
  WHY: A broad ChatGPT refresh failure can push the message past Telegram's 4096-character limit, so Telegram rejects it, no message_id comes back, the script logs `alert=not_delivered`, and the whole hourly alert (Claude part included) is lost; four reviewers rated this MAJOR and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, so the highest is used. Reviewers disagree on the account cap: 64 (`CHATGPT_STATUS_MAX_ACCOUNTS`) or 32 (broker `CHATGPT_MAX_ACCOUNTS`).
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:72-79, 148-154 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `claude_probes_empty=true` and the ChatGPT pool has at least one account, the script no longer exits with `no_probes`, so a `CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT_ITEMS` count above 0 sets `alert=true` and sends "Claude pool exhausted: N item(s) waiting ...; earliest reset unknown." built from empty Claude data.
  WHY: Whether a Claude-only notice goes out now depends on an unrelated pool or switch, and no test covers this combination; suggested fix is to reset `waiting_count=0`/`waiting_text=""` when Claude probes are empty.
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:180-196 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new WARNING rule (`claude_send` AND Claude auth/probe failures, OR `chatgpt_warning`) sends Claude probe-failure cases at DEBUG, or not at all, while the README.md:2752-2754 `CLAUDE_POOL_HEALTH_ALERT_ENABLED` row still says "rejected tokens or failed probes make the notice `WARNING`".
  WHY: Operators filtering at the default WARNING level stop getting notices for cycles where a Claude probe failed, and the documented and shipped behaviour diverge; minimax_minimax-m3 rated this MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, so the highest is used (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 separately rejected the behaviour change as a Claude regression).
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1280, 1386 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `pool_health` returns `"chatgpt_alerts"` as a list of names, while `pool_usage_report` returns the same key as `len(chatgpt_alerts)` (an int).
  WHY: The wrappers work around this with different extraction code (`claude_pool_health_alert.sh:143` vs `claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:119`); no current caller breaks, but a future consumer reading the key the same way from both gets the wrong type.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1281 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The status action runs on every non-capacity poll when `any_claude` is true, not only when the hourly alert window is open.
  WHY: Each read fetches the registry and every account record (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:999-1018), but the alert only sends inside the hourly window, so the extra broker and Durable Object traffic is wasted.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Implement Phase 4 of the ChatGPT account reviewer trial, so operators can see the ChatGPT account's health and usage.
  expected_change_site: Overall PR / Build / CI tests
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR fails the pre-push gate tests (tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py, test_orchestrate_poll_promote_cycle.py, etc.), which suggests the phase's workflow integration is incomplete or broken. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both found these failures unrelated to files in this diff.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:lines 132-134 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `(pool: ${CLAUDE_POOL_REASON})` suffix is applied to the whole text after `pool_usage_report` has appended the ChatGPT section, so it lands on the last ChatGPT line.
  WHY: With `CLAUDE_POOL_PROBES='[]'` (.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml lines 2271-2272), the Claude headline loses its reason and the reason is shown against a ChatGPT line, breaking the "without changing how the existing Claude section is formatted" requirement. Fix: suffix the first line only, and add a send test.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:`CHATGPT_STATUS_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$")` / `_chatgpt_status_parse` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Names longer than 64 characters are silently dropped, but the broker (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts lines 174-175) and scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh line 200 accept any length.
  WHY: Such an account's auth_failed, refresh-failure or stale state is never reported. Fix: use `^[A-Z0-9_]+$`.
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:lines 171-196; scripts/claude_engine.py `pool_health` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The hourly block lists up to 64 accounts with all their causes and is never truncated, and `tg_send_msg` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 108-134) has no guard either.
  WHY: Past 4096 characters Telegram rejects the message, the script logs `alert=not_delivered`, and the alert is lost. Fix: cap the text the way the daily script does.
- scripts/claude_pool_health_alert.sh:lines 72-79, lines 148-154 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With empty Claude probes and one or more ChatGPT accounts, capacity-wait items still send "Claude pool exhausted ... earliest reset unknown."
  WHY: Whether the Claude notice is sent now depends on an unrelated pool, and no test covers this. Fix: reset `waiting_count`/`waiting_text` when Claude probes are empty.
- NOTE: Rejected pass-1 findings: the `./.codex-workflow-src/.github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token` path is valid (orchestrate_poll.yml line 1228); `ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES` covers the workflow (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts line 125); the WARNING-level change is not a Claude regression; the pre-push gate failures and the copilot `custom_instructions_too_large` failure are unrelated; Phase 4 plan deliverables are all present.
- HARDENING: tests/test_claude_pool_daily_usage.py line 53: add "CHATGPT_" to the env prefix filter (1 line). .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml line 1281: the `if:` also needs to handle `0`/`no`/`off`, or the docs should say only `false` skips the read (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
